edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Access refused (exception X2)
    Given the user holds partner-portal right R and not right C
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002 before any read or write, and no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Chosen partner not on the panel (exception X4)
    Given the chosen partner is absent from the panel
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-GEN-001, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC5 Rule-row read does not answer (exception X5)
    Given the rwb-decision rule-row read does not answer within 2 s
    When the action is taken
    Then the step retries on the workflow's own schedule, nothing is written, and the caller sees 503 with the platform error envelope

  Scenario: AC6 Reason absent (exception X6)
    Given the reason is empty
    When the action is taken
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-GEN-001, and nothing is written

  Scenario: AC7 Repeated request (exception X7)
    Given the same Idempotency-Key was sent before
    When the action is repeated with that Idempotency-Key
    Then one replacement exists and the repeat answers the record that exists

  Scenario: AC8 ACE and schema boundary (exception X8)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a recovery_case row or another service's schema
    When the statement is run
    Then the grant refuses it, the boundary test fails the build, and nothing is released
